blocks.text: Condos for Sale in South Surrey, BC

parts.t: This page lists every South Surrey and White Rock condo on the MLS®, at any price. If you have a budget, the under-$800K page narrows the list.
Condo buildings are spread across South Surrey and White Rock, so the listings below cover many areas. To learn about an area before you book a showing, read the guides:

parts.t: FVREB combines South Surrey and White Rock into one statistics area.
See the latest South Surrey and White Rock market numbers
. The numbers include townhouses because many condo buyers here shop both.

Divide a month's sales by active listings. The FVREB package notes that BCREA treats 12–20% as balanced, so a lower reading gives buyers more choice and more room to negotiate. A single month is noisy, so watch the trend.
The benchmark is a modelled "typical" condo, not an average sale price. Age, size, view and building condition move individual prices a long way from it.

What should I check in a condo's strata documents?
Ask for the strata minutes, depreciation report, bylaws and the Form B. I can go through them with you before you write an offer.
Can a strata stop me from renting out my condo?

Not for long-term rentals. Since November 24, 2022, BC strata corporations can't have residential rental-restriction bylaws, and any existing ones are invalid. Stratas can still ban or limit short-term rentals. (
Yes. Since November 24, 2022, the only age-restriction bylaws a strata can have are for 55 and older, with exemptions for some caregivers and family members. (Same source.)
Can I use a South Surrey condo as an Airbnb?

Generally not as an investment. Surrey allows short-term rentals only when the owner lives there as their principal residence, doesn't allow tenants to host, and requires a business licence. A strata can prohibit short-term rentals entirely. (
How much property transfer tax will I save as a first-time buyer?
If you qualify, BC exempts the full tax on homes up to $500,000. Between $500,000 and $835,000 the exemption is $8,000, and it phases out between $835,000 and $860,000. (
What should I review before buying a condo?

The strata documents: minutes, the depreciation report, the budget and contingency reserve, bylaws, and the Form B Information Certificate. Form B now has to include a summary of the strata's insurance coverage. (
